{{nihongo|'''Awabitamashiratama-hime-no-Mikoto Shrine'''|鮑玉白珠比咩命神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in Nishiura Kishō, {{ill|Numazu|Q241037|qid=Q241037}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}.<ref>[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4403266 Awabitama Shiratamahime-no-Mikoto Shrine] - Shizuoka Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines</ref> {{nihongo|'''Awabitamashiratama-hime-no-Mikoto Shrine'''|鮑玉白珠比咩命神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

== Overview ==
The shrine is situated on elevated ground at Akasaki Cape, where the Kishō seawall extends, to the northwest of the Kishō district of Nishiura.

Although the date of its founding is unknown, it is identified with the {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} of the same name, '''Awabitama Shiratamahime-no-Mikoto Shrine''' (あわびたましらたまひめ（の）みことじんじゃ), and is an ancient shrine recorded in the '{{ill|Izu Province Shrine Rank Register|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}}' as “Junior Fourth Rank, Upper Grade, Miyatama no Myōjin.”<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/awabi_title.htm Awabitama Shiratamahime-no-Mikoto Shrine] - Genmatsuko</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140224-01.html Awabitama Shiratamahime-no-Mikoto Shrine] - Research on Engishiki Shrines</ref>

In Meiji 40 ({{ill|1907|Q2048|qid=Q2048}}), it was ranked as a village shrine.<ref name="engi"/>

== Enshrined deity ==
* Awabitama Shiratamahime-no-Mikoto (あわびたま しらたまひめの みこと)
